claim: Built a fresh adaptive-paper-r20260925 venv from a hash lock derived from the live adaptive-paper-20260921 venv's read-only pip freeze; uv pip sync --require-hashes installed the identical 21-package set and versions with no dependency drift.
method: Read the live venv's exact versions read-only (uv pip freeze), wrote them as a pinned requirements.in, generated a hash-locked requirements.lock with uv pip compile --generate-hashes against the same interpreter, then created the new venv and installed strictly from that lock with uv pip sync --require-hashes.

commands.label: freeze-live-readonly
commands.note: Read-only; no write to the live venv.

comparison_to_live_venv.method: diff of sorted `uv pip freeze` output between the live venv (read-only) and the new venv
comparison_to_live_venv.result: IDENTICAL package set and versions; zero drift

isolation.network_used: PyPI package resolution/download only (https://pypi.org/simple); no Alpaca or other market-data endpoint contacted

limitations: Version/hash equivalence to the live venv, not a runtime behavioral acceptance of adaptive-paper itself; no strategy, paper order, or broker call was exercised in this track.
PyPI wheel hashes are trusted from the index at build time; no independent third-party wheel-signature verification beyond uv's --require-hashes content check.
The live venv's actual running process/state was not inspected; only its installed-package versions were read via pip freeze.
sanitization: Host paths use the ${STACK_HOME} placeholder for ~/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools. No credential values, session identifiers, or raw provider data appear in this receipt.
